scientific_integrity: Explicit analytic proof of finite spectra and asymptotic measure, numerical test not used as infinite proof. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Complete regular finite trees only, fixed integer branching factor b >= 2, and the displayed square-root offspring normalization. The asserted spectral mixture is established analytically; finite numerical tests corroborate it. Bibliographic priority is not certified and related shift decompositions and one-block spectra were previously known.
title: Dense atomic singular laws for normalized ancestor sums on homogeneous trees
